name: dsh-reasoning-effort
description: DeepSeek Harness 的思考强度滑块：把当前模型的 reasoning effort 从宿主目录里读出来，用一条 CDS 风格的离散滑轨改写 session.selectModel，档位数量完全由提供商声明，未声明就没有滑块。 / A thinking-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness: reads the current model's reasoning efforts from the host catalog and writes the chosen level through session.selectModel. The stop count comes from the provider — no metadata, no slider.
